Nora (Product): @channel FYI were GA-ing Fast Lane tomorrow 08:30 PT. Fast Lane is a hosted low-latency path optimized for short-turn chats, quick tool calls, and interactive widgets. This is optional (opt-in) and aims to cut median latency by ~40% for targeted workloads. Quick rollout notes below :rocket:

Ben (Eng): Opt-in mechanics? Breaking changes?

Nora (Product): No breaking changes. Clients opt in with header `X-Fast-Lane: 1` or `?fastlane=true`. Example curl: 

```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \n     -H "X-Fast-Lane: 1" \n     -d '{"model":"mosaicx-lite","input":"What's my next meeting?","stream":true}' \n     https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```

Zoe (Docs): Docs PR merged: https://git.redwood/docs/pulls/4620  includes migration note, SDK flag examples, and a short set of troubleshooting items (connection spikes, tokenization differences). Will publish at deploy time.

Harpreet (SRE): Ops: canary sequence us-west-2 -> us-east-1 -> eu-west-1. Canary window 20m. Abort criteria: sustained p50 > 250ms or error rate >1.6x baseline. Fast Lane uses a separate pool; fallback routes to standard `/v1/generate` for 15m if SLOs are breached. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/fastlane-ga.

Kai (ML): Model note: we've tuned small-batch kernel selection and KV prefetching. Eval on 9 tool-heavy suites shows no semantic regressions; token cost for these workloads drops ~5-10%. We'll monitor function call fidelity via eval hooks.

Ben (Eng): Any change to tool-calling payloads or ordering?

Nora (Product): No schema changes. Fast Lane preserves function call ordering; the runtime handles prefetching and caching. SDKs will expose `fastLane: true`.

Harpreet (SRE): DeployBot scheduled job fl-197555. Canary started -> logs posted here when live.

DeployBot: Canary started (job fl-197555)  logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/fl-197555/logs

Harpreet (SRE): Canary +7m: p50 85ms, errors flat. Proceeding to next region.

Ben (Eng): I added Fast Lane metrics to Console: per-key fast-lane hit rate, p50/p95, and fallback counts.

Zoe (Docs): Migration note published under /docs/fast-lane. Sending release email copy to growth for tomorrow.

Nora (Product): Action items: Eng/SRE watch canary and be ready to rollback first 20m; Docs publish and notify; ML watch eval hooks for call mismatches. We'll share GA usage + cost impact in 48h.

DeployBot: Canary complete: success. Global rollout proceeding.

Harpreet (SRE): Global rollout finished. No aborts. Closing monitoring window in 10m.

Nora (Product): Thanks team! If you see customer regressions tag @Harpreet. Excited to get faster experiences into production :sparkles:
